reserves.name: USDC supplied through Smokehouse-curated Morpho lending markets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Morpho Blue borrowers and Circle USDC

reserveReview.rationale: The official Morpho vault page identifies USDC as the Smokehouse vault asset and Steakhouse Financial as curator. Morpho documents that a V1 vault has one loan asset and allocates deposits across multiple Morpho markets. The full reserve therefore remains a linked USDC wrapper position, while its high risk reflects the vault's broad collateral set and lending-market loss and liquidity exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Morpho Smokehouse USDC vault asset and documented V1 allocation model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The entire reserve relationship is classified as USDC deployed through Morpho; borrower-collateral allocations change onchain but do not change the underlying reserve token relationship.

providers.name: Smokehouse USDC MetaMorpho vault and Morpho Blue market contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Assets are held by identifiable noncustodial vault and market contracts, with idle and market allocations changing over time. Reuse is explicit because USDC is supplied to borrower markets. Contract-level isolation does not establish legal bankruptcy remoteness, and no static provider allocation is appropriate.
